posts.subject: rank system
posts.bodyHtml:
Good evening,


I have a question. I played on knife server today and saw that the rank system is back. I was glad. But then I got killed by guy with 1200 points and lost more than 30 points. Then I killed a guy with almost same point as me and got 2 points... Using simple mathematics I calculated that I need K/D ratio 15 to keep my rank. I ask you if it is meant to be like that or if it is not. If it is I am complaining and I suggest to adjust it a little bit. If it is not and it is going to be fixed please answer and I will be happy 😄


Best regards
Thorin [thanksforit*]

Hello,


weirdly enough, there is no setting to change the global multiplier of the points recieved.
However, I was able to change the multiplier of the points lost. It is now only 50%.


Here are some examples:


Before the update:
A: 3000 points
B: 1000 Points


Person B kills person A and therefore person B gets 10 points and person A loses 10 points.
--> A: 2990 Points
--> B: 1010 Points


After the update:
A: 3000 points
B: 1000 Points


Person B kills person A and therefore person B gets 10 points and person A loses 5 points,
since 10 points * 50% = 5 points.


--> A: 2995 Points
--> B: 1010 Points


TL;DR:
The killer still gets the full points but the victim only loses half of the points that the killer got.
________________________________________________________________________________


EDIT:
This update was reverted, see my post below.
@Nachtfrische Thank you very much. I am glad that you have sorted it out so fast. Now it is understandable and fair. [thanksforit*]
I expect exploitation of this change 🙂

indeed. Sry @Nachtfrische but this is bullshit.
Makes it easy to teamboost. There was kind of natural top-"border". Only the good players were able to stay there. They had to do a good job constantly. With this update it doesnt need so much to stay top. Furthermore the points wil rise and rise. This is very unfair for the new players. After some time they wont be able to reach the tpp players. This was the same on rpg some months ago. Nobody did anything against that because 'you always have to be good to stay on top'.


Settings before the update were not unfair. ANY top player would lose the points. AND with the upadte u generate more points then there would be naturally that is bullshit.


Gratz

Zitat von Mike

Makes it easy to teamboost (...) AND with the upadte u generate more points then there would be naturally that is bullshit.

Hey,


I have thought of an inflation of points, but you raise some good points of it being unfair to new players. However, I haven't thought about exploting the change, which could be done very easily and even through normal gameplay.
That fact alone makes it a bad change, I admin.


The update is now reverted back to it's original state, thanks for the feedback.
@Mike After reading your argument I agree. It would become easily exploitable but I still think that rank system needs some balance.

hi Thorin,

But anyway i dont know how many points players on the knife server have usually. On surf server some players had up to 8-12k points because rpg gave them a big advantage. This would not be so unfair and would cause that you can keep your rank even with lower kd.
Anyway it should nit be possible to stay topranked if you die and die and die because then you are (sorry for beeing hard) not worth to be TOP ranked.


i hope you can follow my explainings

Just want to add (I die like normal good player would do it happens) I had around 3900+ in points and I'm a fairly good player, but after 2 days BOOM 2100 points, I'm just sitting here like "dafuq happend" but now when it's been "fixed" I guess it's no more problem

Hello,


I've re-enabled the auto-hide feature of the rank plugin.
That means, if you're inactive for 14 days or longer, you won't show up at !top.
Returning afterwards will put you back at !top again, with the same points / K.D. etc.


I couldn't enable this earlier because there were some issues with the rank database and the new plugin.


This feature also has the benefit of you now losing less points, since there are now "less" total players, so this issue has been fixed as well.
@Thorin Pikachu


Thank you for your patience.
Good to hear this awesome news. Thanks
